lines.text: King Nebuchadnezzar sets up a golden statue on the plain of Dura and gathers all the officials for its dedication.
A herald commands every nation to worship the statue when the music plays, or be thrown into the lions' den.
Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego say God is able to deliver them, but even if He does not, they will not worship the statue.
Nebuchadnezzar orders the furnace heated ten times hotter, and mighty men of his army tie up the three and throw them in.
The king sees four men walking unharmed in the fire, and the three come out without even a smell of fire on them.
